description: Replace schedules.js localStorage-based schedule registration with MemberSchedulePreference API. Rename 'Lịch Class' to 'Đặt Lịch Tập'. Member selects day of week (Thứ 2-CN) and time range (start/end time pickers), submits to POST /api/MemberSchedulePreference. Display existing preferences grouped by day. Allow cancel (DELETE). Remove all localStorage schedule logic (registerSchedule, cancelSchedule, getMyScheduleIds, saveMyScheduleIds).
steps: Read wwwroot/js/schedules.js to understand current localStorage implementation (lines 7-64)

Read Controllers/MemberSchedulePreferenceController.cs to understand API: GET /member/{memberId} returns array, POST body is { memberId, dayOfWeek (0-6), startTime: 'HH:MM:SS', endTime: 'HH:MM:SS' }, DELETE /{preferenceId}
In renderMemberships() for Member view (line 66), change card title from 'Lịch Tập Có Sẵn' to 'Đặt Lịch Tập'
Replace 'Lịch Của Tôi' section: instead of fetching all schedules and filtering by localStorage IDs, call GET /api/MemberSchedulePreference/member/{memberId}
Render preferences grouped by dayOfWeek (Monday=1, Sunday=0), sorted. Show dayOfWeekName, startTime-endTime (format HH:MM), and Delete button
Remove registerSchedule() and cancelSchedule() functions that use localStorage
Add UI to create new preference: form with checkboxes for days (Thứ Hai=1, Thứ Ba=2, ... Chủ Nhật=0), time inputs for start/end, submit button
On submit: for each checked day, POST /api/MemberSchedulePreference with { memberId, dayOfWeek, startTime: value+':00', endTime: value+':00' }
Handle delete: call DELETE /api/MemberSchedulePreference/{preferenceId}, reload list
acceptance_criteria: Page title or heading shows 'Đặt Lịch Tập'
Member can select one or more days of week via checkboxes
Member can pick start time and end time (use <input type='time'>)
Submitting creates preferences via API (not localStorage)
Existing preferences load from API and display grouped by day
Delete button removes preference via API
No localStorage schedule IDs remain after this change
verification: Navigate to Lịch Class page (#schedules) - verify heading says 'Đặt Lịch Tập'
Check day checkboxes (e.g., Thứ Hai, Thứ Tư), enter time 08:00-10:00, submit
Verify success toast and preferences appear in list below
Refresh page - verify preferences persist (loaded from API)
Click Delete button - verify preference removed
Check browser console - no localStorage 'memberSchedules_' keys should be used
